T: Back to high school. Back to the cafeteria.
D: Two bumbling young cops go undercover as high school students.
P: Serve the mains when Schmidt throws the house party.
S: Thick tray pizza with pepperoni and mozzarella, cut into squares
Pizza dough pressed into an oiled tray, crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni right to the edges, baked at 240C for 15 minutes, cut into school-lunch squares.
Crisp tortillas filled with melted cheddar, spring onion and pickled jalapeños

Crisp folded tortillas filled with melted cheddar, spring onion and jalapeño, cut into wedges with salsa. Lay 4 large tortillas flat and cover half of each with 200g grated cheddar, sliced spring onion and a few pickled jalapeños. Fold over and cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
Jenko's surprise talent in chemistry, alcohol-free

Three layers of raspberry, lime and orange juice jelly set in little cups like a test tube rack, topped with whipped cream. Soften 3 tsp gelatine powder in 3 tbsp cold water for each layer. Warm 200ml raspberry juice with 1 tbsp sugar, stir in one lot of gelatine and pour into 12 small cups. Chill 1 hour. Repeat with 200ml lime cordial mixed with water, then with 200ml orange juice, chilling 1 hour between. Top with a dot of whipped cream.
M: the party at Schmidt's parents' place

Smashed beef sliders with melted cheddar, slow-cooked butter onions, pickles and a mustard mayo on soft slider buns. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp American mustard. Smash the balls thin on a smoking griddle, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and top with cheddar. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patties, onions, pickles and mustard mayo.
Pan roasted chicken in mushroom cream sauce, creamy potato gratin
Chicken breasts pan-roasted with butter and thyme, a creamy mushroom sauce, potato gratin and green beans, like a fancy prom dinner.
W: Chocolate cupcakes piped with vanilla buttercream
Chocolate cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with vanilla buttercream, topped with a little mortarboard of a chocolate square and a lolly button.
K: Chocolate ice cream, milk and malt powder blended thick in a chocolate lined glass

Cold milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malt powder and a drizzle of melted dark chocolate, topped with whipped cream and malt balls. Melt 60g dark chocolate and drizzle it inside four tall glasses, then chill. Blend 800ml cold milk, 8 scoops chocolate ice cream and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a few crushed malt balls.

s.note: Thick tray pizza with pepperoni and mozzarella, cut into squares
s.how: Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled tray. Spread a tin of crushed tomatoes with oregano right to the edges and top with 250g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake at 240C for 15 minutes and cut into squares.

s.note: Crisp tortillas filled with melted cheddar, spring onion and pickled jalapeños
s.how: Lay 4 large tortillas flat and cover half of each with 200g grated cheddar, sliced spring onion and a few pickled jalapeños. Fold over and cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

m.note: Pan roasted chicken in mushroom cream sauce, creamy potato gratin
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts in 40g butter with thyme. Fry 250g mushrooms in the pan and add 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: Chocolate cupcakes piped with vanilla buttercream
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour, 30g cocoa and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe vanilla buttercream from 150g butter and 300g icing sugar. Top with a square of chocolate and a lolly button.

d.note: Chocolate ice cream, milk and malt powder blended thick in a chocolate lined glass
d.how: Melt 60g dark chocolate and drizzle it inside four tall glasses, then chill. Blend 800ml cold milk, 8 scoops chocolate ice cream and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a few crushed malt balls.
